info.name: Instacompay Gateway API (v1)
info.description:
Import this collection, fill in three variables, and send a request. There is no signing and no scripts to configure.

## Setup
1. Open the collection's **Variables** tab.
2. Paste your `apiKey`, `apiSecret` and `accountId`. You get these from the Merchant Portal under API Documentation. Regenerating a sandbox key reveals them once.
3. Press **Send** on any request.

## Authentication
Every request carries two headers:

    X-Api-Key: {{apiKey}}
    X-Api-Secret: {{apiSecret}}

You can send `Authorization: Bearer <secret>` instead of `X-Api-Secret` if you prefer.

The full integration guide is at https://merchants.instacompayzm.com/developers

## Rails
Only rails that are live in production are accepted, which currently means AIRTEL and MTN. Zamtel, Zed Mobile and Visa are not yet available. Sandbox rejects anything production would reject, so if a request works here it will work when you go live.

## Amounts
All amounts are integer ngwee, sent as strings. K1.50 is "150" and K50.00 is "5000". Do not send decimals.

## Refunds
There is no reverse or void call. To refund a customer, send a disbursement for `total_amount` from the original transaction. That field is what the customer was actually debited, so you do not have to work it out from `amount` and `charge`. See the "Refund a customer" request.

## Sandbox
Start with a sandbox key (`ic_sand_`). Sandbox simulates and settles immediately, so no real money moves and no float is used, and you can test the full PROCESSING to SUCCESS lifecycle.

An `Idempotency-Key` is set automatically on every write. Send the same value again to safely retry a request.

request.description:
Charge a customer's mobile money wallet. The amount is in ngwee, so "5000" is K50.00. The processor is currently AIRTEL. MTN is not yet enabled in production and returns a clear 400.

In production this prompts the customer's phone and returns PROCESSING. Poll the status request until it returns SUCCESS. Sandbox settles immediately.
Send money to a customer's wallet. The msisdn is required and must be 12 digits, for example 260970000001. This dispatches to the rail immediately.

There is no reverse or void call. A refund is a real transfer back to the customer.

Amount: send `total_amount` from the original transaction. That is exactly what the customer was debited, whether they covered the fee or you did. Do not use `net_amount`, which is what you received after the fee.

Reconciliation: put the original order in collectionReference so the refund ties back to it.

This returns its own transaction id. Poll the status request to confirm it landed.

Status of any transaction, whether a collection or a disbursement. The txnId is filled in automatically from the last create request. This re-enquires the rail on read.

Statuses are PROCESSING, then SUCCESS or FAILED.
Balance enquiry for your account. The balance is in ngwee.
Settlements for the account behind the API key.
